name: Valhalla’s Fury
body:
You share the same rage of the worthy warriors you come to aid or collect.

Prerequisites: 1st level valkyrie, vanquish foe class feature.

Benefits: You can expend one use of your vanquish foe ability to rage as a barbarian for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution bonus. You can use your valkyrie rage powers while raging as normal.
